trap.label: discuss about
trap.wrong: This essay will discuss about both views.
trap.right: This essay will discuss both views.
trap.why: Em português "discutir sobre" é comum. Em inglês discuss é transitivo e não leva about.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao passado: “Sales rise in May.”
Reescreva com although: “It is cheap. It is poor.”
rewrite.answer: Although it is cheap, it is poor.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a negativa: “The text mentions the cost.”
rewrite.answer: The text does not mention the cost.
